title: A world of human curiosity
dedication: A little tribute to the people who learned to read the sky.
story: A little tribute to the people who turned questions about the sky into gears. Imagine carrying that curiosity into a world of your own.

curiosities.subject: object
curiosities.title: Questions about the sky, answered in gears
curiosities.text: The National Archaeological Museum describes the Antikythera Mechanism as a first-century-BC scientific instrument for astronomical and calendar forecasts. This gift is an artistic reference, not an authenticated reconstruction.
